purpose: The deterministic half of the customer command system: what a typed command means, before any model sees it. The parser reads this file, produces a Normalized Intent, and only falls through to the AI agent when nothing here matches. Prose reference: ../COMMAND-SPECIFICATION.md

grammar.colon_form: /<command>:<arg1> — accepted, and equivalent to a space before the FIRST argument only. `/support:vendor` is `/support vendor`.
rules: Diacritic-insensitive on the command name, so `/categorie` matches `/catégorie`. Arguments keep their accents.
A trailing `@botname` is stripped — Telegram appends it in group chats.
Leading and repeated whitespace is collapsed. A trailing `:` with no argument is the bare command.
Quoted arguments hold together: `/search "red dress"` is one argument.
Unquoted trailing arguments are joined for free-text commands (search, cancel reason), and split for identifier commands.
A message that does not begin with `/` is never a command. It goes to the AI agent.

canonical_name_rule.why: Telegram's bot_command entity accepts only letters, digits and underscore. `/reset-password` is parsed by Telegram as the command `/reset` with the text `-password` after it, and it cannot be registered with BotFather for autocomplete. Canonical names are therefore underscore-safe; every hyphenated form the platform has ever published is kept as an alias, and the parser reads the RAW MESSAGE TEXT rather than Telegram's entity so both keep working.

grammar.unknown_command: Do not guess and do not execute. Reply with the closest match by edit distance if one is within 2 edits, otherwise offer /help. An unknown command must never be forwarded to the AI agent as if it were prose — a typo'd /cancel must not become a cancellation.

resolution_order: 1. Exact match on a canonical name.
3. Interactive payload — a button or list-row the bot itself sent. This carries its own intent and arguments and NEVER re-enters the parser.
4. A live flow's expected input (an OTP, a chosen address, a confirmation). A flow in progress consumes the message before anything else interprets it.
5. AI agent intent classification over free text.

argument_types.product_ref: A product id (24 hex), a SKU, a storefront URL, or an ordinal referring to a list the bot just sent ('2', 'the second one').
argument_types.order_ref: An order number (ORD-YYYY-NNNNNN), an order id, or an ordinal from a list the bot just sent.
argument_types.ticket_ref: A ticket number (TKT-NNNN) or a ticket id.
argument_types.language_code: One of en, fr, pt, es, ar. Also accepted: the language's own name in any of the five.

commands.name: start
commands.purpose: First contact. Establishes who the sender is and, if they have no account, offers to create one.

platform.telegram: The conventional first command; Telegram sends it automatically when a user opens the bot. Register it with BotFather.
platform.whatsapp: There is no /start convention. ANY first message from an unknown sender enters the same flow.

commands.name: help
commands.purpose: What the bot can do — narrowed to what this sender can actually do right now.

platform.whatsapp: Render as an interactive list of at most 10 rows, grouped by area, not as a wall of text.
platform.telegram: Inline keyboard, and keep the BotFather command list in step with this registry.

commands.name: login
commands.purpose: Sign in on the website without a password.
commands.back_compat: LIVE. Already mapped in n8n and documented in auth/N8N-HANDOFF.md item 1. Its behaviour must not change.

platform.telegram: requestContact: true means attach the 'Share my phone number' keyboard. disable_web_page_preview: true.

commands.name: reset_password
commands.purpose: Get a link to choose a new password. The only command that serves vendors, agencies and agents as well as customers.
commands.back_compat: LIVE. n8n maps it to command `reset_password` with an UNDERSCORE while the user types a hyphen — handoff item 2.

platform.telegram: Telegram's bot_command entity stops at the hyphen, so this MUST be parsed from the raw message text. It cannot be registered with BotFather in its hyphenated form; register `/reset_password` and keep the hyphen as an alias.

commands.name: connect
commands.purpose: Get a 6-character code to connect this chat to an existing account on the website.
commands.back_compat: LIVE. Do not change. If /connect stops working after a change, something shared broke — fix that before looking anywhere else.

commands.name: search
commands.purpose: Find something to buy.

args.name: query
args.on_missing: reprompt: what are you looking for?

platform.whatsapp: Results as an interactive list, 5 rows, with a 'Show more' row when meta.pages > 1.

commands.name: categories
commands.purpose: What kinds of thing are sold here.

commands.name: category
commands.purpose: Browse one category. With no argument, lists the categories to choose from.

args.name: name
args.on_missing: list the categories and let them pick — do not guess

commands.notes: Category is free text with no taxonomy behind it, so an unrecognised name must be matched against the live list rather than passed through — an unknown value returns an empty page, which reads as 'we sell nothing like that'.

commands.name: product
commands.purpose: Open one product.

args.name: ref
args.on_missing: resolve from the product in focus; if none or several, ask

commands.notes: SKU resolution is BUILT (GAP-003, 2026-08-26): catalog_resolve_sku. Send the code exactly as typed — as-typed, uppercase and lowercase are all tried and the as-typed spelling wins. It answers the VARIANT's price and stock, not the product card's. On a 404 fall back to a text search and say it was searched for rather than looked up.

commands.name: store
commands.purpose: See a seller and what they sell.

args.name: slug
args.on_missing: resolve from the product or order in focus

commands.name: similar
commands.purpose: Other products related to this one.
commands.notes: The heading must follow meta.source. Never say 'customers also bought' when the source is same_category.

commands.name: reviews
commands.purpose: What buyers said about a product.

commands.name: cart
commands.purpose: See and change the basket.

platform.whatsapp: The cart view carries at most 3 buttons — Checkout, Modify, Clear. Line-level edits go through a list, not buttons.

commands.name: add_to_cart
commands.purpose: Put something in the basket. A shorthand for /cart add.

args.name: ref
args.on_missing: resolve from the product in focus, and NAME it in the reply

commands.notes: A product with more than one variant ALWAYS asks which one, even when only one product is in focus. Context resolves the product; it never resolves the variant.

commands.name: checkout
commands.purpose: Buy what is in the basket.

commands.name: buy
commands.purpose: Buy one thing straight away.
commands.notes: Express checkout adds to the SAME cart — there is no separate buy-now basket. When the cart already holds something, say so and offer to check out everything or to empty it first. Silently discarding an existing basket is not acceptable.

commands.name: pay
commands.purpose: Pay for an order that is still waiting for payment.

args.name: ref
args.on_missing: list unpaid orders and let them choose

commands.notes: Payment is against the checkout GROUP (cartId), not the single order. A cash-on-delivery order has no online payment and the command must say so rather than failing.

commands.name: orders
commands.purpose: The customer's orders.

commands.name: order
commands.purpose: One order in detail.

args.name: ref
args.on_missing: the order in focus, named back; otherwise list

commands.name: track
commands.purpose: Where a parcel is.

args.name: ref
args.on_missing: the single order in flight, named back; if several, list them

commands.notes: There is no live map in chat. Report the stage, the history and the delivery company's contacts. estimatedDelivery is always null — never invent a date.

commands.name: code
commands.purpose: The secret code to give the delivery agent for a cash-on-delivery parcel.

args.name: ref
args.on_missing: list cash orders awaiting collection — never guess

commands.notes: Only ever on an explicit request. Always with the warning. Never written to the conversation transcript. Never included in an order summary.

commands.name: confirm
commands.purpose: Tell the platform a parcel arrived.
commands.notes: Refused on cash orders — those are confirmed by handing over the code. Do not offer the action for a cash parcel; offer the code instead.

commands.name: cancel
commands.purpose: Call off an order or an appointment.

args.name: ref
args.on_missing: list what is cancellable — never assume

commands.notes: Never resolved from context. A paid order cannot be cancelled here and needs a refund conversation — say so rather than failing silently.

commands.name: address
commands.purpose: See and manage where orders are delivered.

platform.whatsapp: Offer location sharing first — it is the fastest route to a deliverable address. Fall back to typing, then a candidate list.
platform.telegram: Ask with a request_location keyboard button rather than in prose.

commands.notes: Editing and deleting an address are deliberately NOT commands. Editing in place has consequences for past orders that reference the address id, and neither is something a chat window does well. Both hand off to the website.

commands.name: language
commands.purpose: Change the language the platform writes in.
commands.notes: Five languages: en, fr, pt, es, ar. The change reaches email and notifications too, so it is durable rather than per-conversation. Product text is never translated.

commands.name: profile
commands.purpose: What the platform holds about the customer.
commands.notes: Contact details come back masked. Changing an email or a phone number is a verification flow and hands off to the website; closing an account always does.

commands.name: notifications
commands.purpose: Which messages the customer gets, and where.

commands.name: stop
commands.purpose: Stop receiving messages on this channel.
commands.notes: Must be honest: it moves the secondary channel off this one, and payment, refund and cancellation messages are NOT silenceable by any setting. Say both. Promising silence the platform will break is worse than saying no.

platform.whatsapp: Meta expects an opt-out keyword to be honoured. This is it, and it must work from a bare 'STOP' with no slash.

commands.name: support
commands.purpose: Reach whoever can actually help — the seller, the delivery company, or the platform.
commands.notes: The bare form walks a relevance ladder and NAMES what it routed from. `agency` has nothing to answer with until an order has shipped — that is a legitimate empty answer, not an error.

commands.name: ticket
commands.purpose: Open support requests, or one of them in detail.

commands.name: saved
commands.purpose: Products kept for later.

commands.name: downloads
commands.purpose: Files the customer bought.
commands.notes: A link is single-use and lasts 15 minutes. Mint one at a time, on request, and never for several files at once.

commands.name: bookings
commands.purpose: Appointments the customer has booked.
commands.notes: Read and cancel only. MAKING a booking needs a slot locked against a live calendar within 15 minutes and hands off to the website — see COMMAND-SPECIFICATION.md for why.

commands.name: review
commands.purpose: Rate something the customer bought or a delivery they received.
commands.notes: A star rating alone publishes immediately; a review with words waits for a moderator. Say which will happen before submitting. Never write the customer's words for them.

removed_from_proposal.reason: There is no region concept on a customer anywhere in the backend. A country lives on each saved address (defaulting to CM), currency lives on preferences, and the platform's search bias is a server-side environment variable. A /region command would be a setting that changes nothing. If a delivery-region preference is wanted it is a new field and a new decision — recorded as GAP-010.
Kept as an alias of /cart. Two commands for one screen is two things to document and two to translate.
Kept as aliases of /buy and /cart add. The published hyphenated forms keep working; the canonical names are Telegram-registrable.
